name: Signup Sheets
description: Volunteer and potluck signup sheets. Create a sheet of slots — what to bring, how to serve, which shift to take — and let members claim them inside the CRM or through a shareable public link.
author: ChurchCRM Team

settings.label: Allow public share links
settings.help: When enabled, a sheet can be published at a secret link that anyone can use without a CRM login.

settings.label: Public signups per hour per visitor
settings.help: Maximum signups accepted from one IP address per hour on public sheets. Rejected submissions are throttled separately, at five times this number.

settings.label: Sheet contact email
settings.help: Shown on public sheets so volunteers know who to ask about the event.
